purpose: Execution fix on top of amendment v1: the v1 run OOM'd on MPS (182.66 GiB) inside a 255-candidate microbatch during seed17 step ~2. Amendment v1's token budget (32768) correctly covers the complete-question footprint (max measured 29070) but nothing bounds activation memory for a 28k-token single forward+backward on unified memory. The trainer already carries an opt-in --gradient-checkpointing flag (use_reentrant=false) that recomputes backbone activations during backward, cutting peak activation memory by ~an order of magnitude while leaving the loss, normalization, selection rule and checkpoint format bit-identical. This amendment adds that flag to the run CLI. All other v1 parameters are inherited verbatim.

documents.relationship: base frozen protocol; selection/reporting rules inherited verbatim
immediately superseded for execution only; v1 remains the record of the corpus-v4/step/token-budget decisions this run still uses

v1_oom_failure.finding: seed17 completed initial dev eval (target_ce 1.344) then died at training step ~2: RuntimeError MPS out of memory, 182.66 GiB allocated, inside a batch_grid_255 microbatch (255 leaves x ~110 tokens). Failed checkpoint dir renamed to *_failed_oom for evidence; not overwritten.

gradient_checkpointing.mechanism: backbone.gradient_checkpointing_enable(use_reentrant=false): activations recomputed during backward; LoRA A/B and head grads still flow; loss/optimizer/selection unchanged
gradient_checkpointing.justification: Only viable path that keeps the complete-question softmax contract on a 255-candidate family within MPS unified memory; alternative (split softmax / drop family / shrink context) would violate the no-split rule or silently reduce contract coverage

inherited_from_v1.arm: LoRA r16 alpha32 dropout0.05 lr5e-5 on frozen backbone (--backbone-lr 0), head lr 2e-4, warm start checkpoints/local_atomic_seed17/variants/local_atomic_seed17
inherited_from_v1.selection: minimum dev target CE; heldout_v1 (69q) and heldout_v2 (312q) each read once per checkpoint

design.cli: scripts/train_pipeline_decisions_v4.py --input research/engineering_judgment_corpus_v4/trainer_view --output-dir checkpoints/t9d_v5_lora_seed{N} --init-checkpoint checkpoints/local_atomic_seed17/variants/local_atomic_seed17 --objective gold_distribution --loss ce --steps 600 --head-steps 0 --batch-questions 16 --microbatch-questions 4 --max-microbatch-tokens 32768 --eval-every 50 --max-length 2048 --seed {N} --lora-rank 16 --lora-alpha 32 --lora-dropout 0.05 --lora-lr 5e-5 --backbone-lr 0 --head-lr 2e-4 --device mps --precision fp32 --gradient-checkpointing

authorization.heldout_reads: heldout_v1 and heldout_v2 once each per checkpoint, after dev-only selection
